title: Narrative Voice and Free Indirect Discourse
goal: Produce and analyse free indirect discourse in fiction, explaining how merged narrative voices expose irony or unreliability.
grammar: free indirect discourse (tense shift + character-anchored deictics without a reporting verb)

items: I can convert direct or reported thought into free indirect discourse using imperfect, pluperfect, and conditional verbs with character-anchored deictics.
I can identify how an omniscient or unreliable narrator merges prose and interior monologue to create irony.
I can use narrative-voice vocabulary (el monólogo, omnisciente, confiable, la prosa, la ficción, narrativo, delatar).
